name: Bayushi Hirofumi
concept: Hirofumi's eyes don't track the person speaking to him until they have finished their sentence.

answers.giri: Bayushi Hirofumi serves Bayushi Kiku, who oversees the Deathdealers sent along the Shadowlands border, and must ensure that any of their assassins who cross the Wall either return intact or do not return at all.
answers.ninjo: Hirofumi wants to know whether the assassins he sends into the Shadowlands die as themselves or come back wrong, and he cannot ask Kiku without admitting he has already lost track of one.
answers.standout_quality: Hirofumi runs through assassination drills alone at night, drilling the same technique until his movements match those of a man who has never hesitated, never flinched, never needed to know the target's name.
answers.accomplishment: Hirofumi identified three Deathdealer aspirants corrupted by the Shadowlands on their return to the Scorpion lands and killed them before reporting them lost, preventing Kiku from unknowingly deploying tainted assassins into the clan's inner courts.
answers.challenge: When someone approaches Hirofumi with panic in their voice, they watch him decide whether to believe them, and the delay costs them.
answers.peace: Hirofumi strips and cleans each blade after a Shadowlands patrol returns, running his thumb along the edge to test it, and only then permits himself to believe the person still holding it came back whole.
answers.fear: When Hirofumi strikes a target in the Shadowlands, he cannot tell afterward whether he stopped because the threat ended or because something in him finally did.
answers.accoutrement: Vial of Shadowlands soil. Sealed in wax; one per patrol.

clan_relationship.text: Hirofumi reports to Kiku that all Deathdealers who enter the Shadowlands return or do not, which is true, and carefully does not say which assassins he has stopped sending back at all.

mentor.name: Soshi Ujimasa
mentor.text: Soshi Ujimasa taught Hirofumi to pass a season in another clan's castle without anyone remembering his face, and to hear what a mess hall says about a man who has just come back from the Wall; Hirofumi uses it now to sit among returning Deathdealers unremarked and listen for the one who answers a half-beat late.

answers.first_impression: Hirofumi's eyes don't track the person speaking to him until they have finished their sentence.
answers.stress_reaction: Hirofumi stops answering direct questions and instead repeats back what he heard, asking if that is correct, until everyone in the room has confirmed the same version of events or admitted they cannot.
answers.relationships: Isawa Machiko (Phoenix) — Isawa Machiko of the Phoenix came to observe the Deathdealer program three years ago and saw Hirofumi kill a returner from the Shadowlands before it could report; she has never told Kiku, and Hirofumi buys her silence by attending her divinations when she asks, pretending to believe the readings differ from what she already decided to tell him.

people.name: Isawa Machiko
people.text: Isawa Machiko of the Phoenix came to observe the Deathdealer program three years ago and saw Hirofumi kill a returner from the Shadowlands before it could report; she has never told Kiku, and Hirofumi buys her silence by attending her divinations when she asks, pretending to believe the readings differ from what she already decided to tell him.

parent_opinion.description: Hirofumi's mother has not spoken to him about his work in five years, and when he visits the house she prepares his favorite meal and watches him eat without tasting it herself.

answers.heritage: A Little Too Close to Heaven
answers.death: Hirofumi will die in the Shadowlands because he went back alone to find the one he stopped sending back, and no one will know whether he chose not to return or simply could not.
